# GWAS EMMAX Association

Run EMMAX after `gwas-vcf-prep-qc`. EMMAX requires genotype, phenotype, kinship, and covariates to share the same sample order.

## 确认任务边界

Use this ski

ll when:

- The user requests EMMAX, mixed linear model, kinship-corrected GWAS, or fast resequencing GWAS.
- Inputs are PLINK transposed files: `.tped` and `.tfam`.
- A sorted EMMAX phenotype file exists: `FID IID trait`.

Do not use this skill for TASSEL GLM/MLM, GEMMA, GAPIT3, or rMVP; route to their specific skills.

## 调用的参数

Required:

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TPED_PREFIX` | prefix without `.tped/.tfam` |
| `PHENO_EMMAX` | `FID IID trait` phenotype file |
| `OUTDIR` | output root |

Optional:

| Parameter | Default / rule |
|---|---|
| `KINSHIP` | compute from same marker prefix unless valid existing matrix is provided |
| `COVARIATE` | EMMAX format `FID IID intercept covariates...` |
| `PRECISION` | `10` for `-d` |

Kinship:

```bash
emmax-kin-intel64 \
  -v \
  -d "${PRECISION:-10}" \
  -o "${OUTDIR}/02.association/pop.kinship" \
  "${TPED_PREFIX}" \
  > "${OUTDIR}/logs/emmax.kinship.log" 2>&1
```

Association without covariates:

```bash
emmax-intel64 \
  -v \
  -d "${PRECISION:-10}" \
  -t "${TPED_PREFIX}" \
  -p "${PHENO_EMMAX}" \
  -k "${OUTDIR}/02.association/pop.kinship" \
  -o "${OUTDIR}/02.association/emmax" \
  > "${OUTDIR}/logs/emmax.log" 2> "${OUTDIR}/logs/emmax.err"
```

Add covariates only after order validation:

```bash
-c "${COVARIATE}"
```

Standardize result for plotting:

```bash
python skills/population-genetics/gwas-emmax-association/scripts/emmax_to_manhattan.py \
  --tped "${TPED_PREFIX}.tped" \
  --emmax "${OUTDIR}/02.association/emmax.ps" \
  --out "${OUTDIR}/02.association/emmax.manht_input.tsv"
```

## 输出结果

Expected outputs:

- `02.association/pop.kinship`
- `02.association/emmax.ps`
- `02.association/emmax.manht_input.tsv`
- `02.association/emmax_summary.tsv`
- `logs/emmax.log`
- `logs/emmax.err`

Validation:

```bash
test -s "${OUTDIR}/02.association/emmax.ps"
test -s "${OUTDIR}/02.associati

on/emmax.manht_input.tsv"
awk 'NR>1 && ($4 <= 0 || $4 > 1){bad++} END{exit bad>0}' \
  "${OUTDIR}/02.association/emmax.manht_input.tsv"
```

Rows in `emmax.ps` should be close to markers in `.tped`; report mismatches before plotting.

## 常见错误及解决办法

| Problem | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| phenotype and TFAM sample counts differ | sample mismatch | rerun prep and inspect missing samples |
| kinship reused from another marker set | invalid model covariance | recompute kinship or document intentional reuse |
| Q/PCA file order wrong | covariates assigned incorrectly | sort with `sort_phenotype.py` |
| p-values not in final column | output version differs | inspect `emmax.ps` before conversion |
| EMMAX binary missing | environment not ready | report blocked with exact command |

# GWAS LDblock Candida

te Region

Use this skill after significant GWAS loci have been identified. It turns lead markers into windows, annotates genes, and prepares one LDblock job per merged window.

## 确认任务边界

Use this skill when:

- Input includes standardized GWAS table `SNP CHR BP P`.
- Significant sites are already available or a threshold is provided.
- The user asks for candidate genes, nearby genes, in-gene hits, LD heatmaps, or local Manhattan plots.
- A VCF and matching GFF3/GTF annotation are available for LD/gene overlays.

Do not run genome-wide LDblock by default. Do not report candidate genes without threshold and window size.

## 调用的参数

Required:

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `GWAS_TABLE` | standardized `SNP CHR BP P` |
| `VCF` | same marker set/reference used for GWAS |
| `ANNOTATION` | GFF3/GTF matching reference |
| `OUTDIR` | output root |

Optional:

| Parameter | Default / rule |
|---|---|
| `THRESHOLD` | same as Manhattan plot threshold |
| `WINDOW` | `50000` bp each side unless user changes |
| `CUTLINE` | `-log10(THRESHOLD)` |
| `CHR_MAP` | only if chromosome names differ and mapping is validated |

Significant sites:

```bash
mkdir -p "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci" "${OUTDIR}/05.ldblock"
awk -v p="${THRESHOLD}" 'NR==1 || $4 < p' "${GWAS_TABLE}" \
  > "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.tsv"
```

Merged windows:

```bash
awk -v w="${WINDOW:-50000}" 'NR>1 {s=$3-w; if(s<0)s=0; print $2"\t"s"\t"$3+w"\t"$1"\t"$4}' \
  "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.tsv" |
sort -k1,1 -k2,2n \
  > "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.bed"

bedtools merge -i "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.bed" \
  > "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.merged.bed"
```

Candidate genes:

```bash
awk '$3=="gene"' "${ANNOTATION}" > "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/genes.gff3"
bedtools intersect -wo \
  -

a "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.merged.bed" \
  -b "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/genes.gff3" \
  > "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/candidate_genes.tsv"
```

Generate LDblock jobs:

```bash
python skills/population-genetics/gwas-ldblock-candidate-region/scripts/make_ldblock_jobs.py \
  --windows "${OUTDIR}/04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.merged.bed" \
  --vcf "${VCF}" \
  --gwas "${GWAS_TABLE}" \
  --gff "${ANNOTATION}" \
  --outdir "${OUTDIR}/05.ldblock" \
  --cutline "${CUTLINE}" \
  --script "${OUTDIR}/05.ldblock/run_ldblock.sh"
```

- `04.significant_loci/significant_sites.tsv`
- `04.significant_loci/significant_sites.windows.merged.bed`
- `04.significant_loci/candidate_genes.tsv`
- `04.significant_loci/significant_sites.in_genes.tsv`
- `05.ldblock/run_ldblock.sh`
- `05.ldblock/*.png` or `*.svg` after running LDBlockShow.

ype, phenotype, and covariate files before EMMAX or TASSEL association testing.

Required:

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `VCF` | marker VCF, bgzipped and indexed when possible |
| `PHENOTYPE` | table with sample ID and trait |
| `TRAIT` | target trait column |
| `OUTDIR` | output root |

Optional:

| Parameter | Default / rule |
|---|---|
| `MARKER_TYPE` | `snp`; use `indel` or `sv` for relaxed defaults |

Preflight:

```bash

  --recode 12 transpose \

  --set-missing-var-ids @:# \
  --allow-extra-chr \
  --keep-allele-order \
```

```bash
  --tfam "${OUTDIR}/01.prep/markers.tfam" \

  --trait "${TRAIT}" \
  --out-emmax "${OUTDIR}/01.prep/trait.emmax.txt" \
  --out-tassel "${OUTDIR}/01.prep/trait.tassel.txt"
```

```bash
  --phenotype qmatrix.tsv \

  --out-tassel "${OUTDIR}/01.prep/qmatrix.tassel.txt" \
```
